fields.why: Table 2 reports chi-square p-values for test result by race/ethnicity (5 groups, p=0.54) and gender (4 groups, p=0.13); rule 2 and rule 6 make these Table-1 composition tests groupwise.
Gender with Female/Male/Transgender/Other is a gender-identity variable (SOGI); Table 1 sex has only 2 levels and age is a continuous Wilcoxon comparison.
One p-value per characteristic from Pearson chi-square or Fisher's exact test across the levels: omnibus test, with no finer contrasts.
